commands.name: persona
commands.description: Set the role Claude works for on this machine: what it may edit and how it answers
commands.output:
No persona active. Claude can edit any file. Run /persona list.

○ ui-ux    UI/UX Designer: Components, styles, layout and assets only. API, server and database are off limits.
○ backend  Backend Developer: API, server, database and business logic. UI files are off limits.
○ dev      Developer: All application code, frontend and backend. Secrets, CI and infrastructure are off limits.
○ qa       QA Engineer: Tests, fixtures and test config only. Application code is off limits.
○ docs     Technical Writer: Documentation and Markdown only. Code is off limits.
○ pm       Product Manager: Read-only. Explains, explores and plans; changes no project file.

Use /persona <id> to switch, /persona off to clear.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

/persona → No persona active. Claude can edit any file. Run /persona list.

notes: ./register.ts hooks: ui.render{component=SessionMode}, ui.render{component=PromptHint}, session.start, command.run{command=persona|persona:persona}, tool.call{tool=Edit}, tool.call{tool=Write}, tool.call{tool=NotebookEdit}, tool.call{tool=Bash}, prompt.compose

./register.ts hooks on prompt.compose do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them
